title: Dashboard Shell
description: A complete billing overview screen: a sidebar with collapsible sections, a topbar, page actions, section tabs, a dismissible recommendation, a date range panel, ruled metric charts and report downloads. Only the content scrolls.
summary: A full application screen where sidebar, topbar and scrolling content meet.
notes: The shell is Actual CSS's .sidebar-shell: from 64rem it fills the viewport (--viewport-block), the sidebar and the content column scroll on their own and the topbar sticks to the top of the content. Put it at the top of <body>; it is not meant to sit inside a scrolling page.

Below 64rem the sidebar hides, the document scrolls and a native drawer that mirrors the sidebar opens from the menu button (command="show-modal"). A drawer left open when the window widens past 64rem stays over the sidebar; close it from your page with the matchMedia recipe on the Sidebar Shell docs page.

The date range panel is a form flyout (.flyout.scrollable) with vertical segmented presets and native date inputs; Apply and Cancel only close it. Applying the range, updating the trigger label and reloading the charts are your application's job. For a calendar, @lekoala/date-picker has a range mode (<date-picker range>) over the same two inputs.

The recommendation closes with the dismiss enhancer's command="--dismiss", which moves focus to the next tab stop; remembering that it was dismissed is up to your application. Without JavaScript the menus and the date panel stay closed and the recommendation cannot be dismissed.

Charts are static inline SVG with a text summary each; all figures are sample data. The section tabs are links to other views, marked with aria-current="page", not in-place tab panels. Test mode, search and the download links are placeholders.
